The user's agent guidance lives in `~/agenticlibrary` (they may type it as "agentLIbrary"). Read `README.md` and `context.md` first, then recent `sessions/<date>-<topic>/session.md` logs for the class being worked on.

Key rules from context.md: brief explanations, no em dashes in any output, response format of Approach / Code / Key decisions / Complexity / Edge cases / Key lessons, no tests unless asked. The README asks for a session log at the end of each session in `sessions/`.

**Why:** The user asked to refer to it for guidance and context (2026-09-25).
**How to apply:** Read it at the start of CSE4095 tasks and write a session log when done. Related: [[cse4095-notebook-workflow]]

Never run `git commit` or `git push` (or other git writes) in CSE4095 work. The user does all of that themselves.

**Why:** Stated explicitly by the user on 2026-10-06 (Class 11 kickoff): "Do not ever commit to github or push on your own."
**How to apply:** Leave changes in the working tree. Don't offer to commit unless asked. Related: [[step-by-step-prompts]]

The user provides each Part's prompt themselves (from their prompt set). Do only the Part asked. Don't read ahead in ~/agenticlibrary (e.g. the stored Class 11 prompt set) and build later Parts on my own.

**Why:** User said on 2026-10-06: "I will provide future prompts for you to do, do not just read from agenticLIbrary and go ahead."
**How to apply:** Finish the requested Part, report, and stop. Use the library for conventions only. Related: [[agentic-library]], [[no-git-commits]]

Only comment on things a reader cannot infer from the code: a non-obvious constraint, a workaround, or a design reason. Don't narrate what a line does, and don't add JSDoc to obvious components.

**Why:** User asked for this at the start of class13-mathapp Phase 2 (2026-10-21). It reinforces the comment rule in ~/agenticlibrary/context.md.
**How to apply:** Pass this rule on to coding subagents in their prompts, and strip any narrating comments when reviewing their output. Related: [[subagent-model-routing]], [[agentic-library]]

When delegating CSE4095 work, use Sonnet subagents for coding tasks, Haiku for reading/parsing/verification, and Opus for design or deep-reasoning work. They also want a visible progress bar (class13 uses `node progress.mjs` to turn TODO.md checkboxes into PROGRESS.md).

**Why:** Stated by the user at the class13-mathapp kickoff (2026-10-21).
**How to apply:** Name the model and its role when spawning agents; refresh the progress bar after checking off TODO items. Related: [[step-by-step-prompts]], [[no-git-commits]]
